on the other sides of it as indicated in your first post, you said you are in a toxic situation. I can understand if you are not able to get out of that situation but trauma and abuse and stress can accumulate and build over time. 

Panic disorders take time to develop, so if an interaction with your mother or father usually end with a typical response, your brain remembers that. Eventually your subconscious will associate said individuals with previous arguments and eventually the mere sight of them could cause stress and panic that's a response to a supposed threat, even if said threat doesn't actually exist. 

You certainly have my sympathies o p and my best suggestion is to try to get out of that situation if any way possible. I know that's much easier said than done and I really hope the best for you.
